import json,os,stat,tempfile,subprocess,urllib.request,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/srv/projects/skill-universal")
release=root/"releases/0a1a4c190a7d33752d6dc3f4418ed44735c8a7dd"
sha="39afa477dc590e4355de8ee5af812c7ba251bb13"
url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martaxi-boss/skill-universal/"+sha+"/install/vps-android-cli-isolated.sh"
dest=release/"install/vps-android-cli-isolated.sh"
state=root/".runtime/android-cli"
report={"operation":"fix Ferrari Android worker private state ownership","status":"NOT_COMPLETE"}
temp=None
try:
 assert root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink() and release.is_dir()
 assert dest.is_file() and not dest.is_symlink() and state.is_dir() and not state.is_symlink()
 source=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=22).read(20000)
 assert source.startswith(b"#!/usr/bin/env bash") and b"fix_private_state()" in source and b'chown -R --reference="$ROOT"' in source
 old=dest.read_bytes()
 stats=dest.stat()
 fd,temp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".android-cli-owner-",dir=str(dest.parent))
 with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as h:
  h.write(source);h.flush();os.fsync(h.fileno())
 os.chown(temp,stats.st_uid,stats.st_gid);os.chmod(temp,stat.S_IMODE(stats.st_mode))
 os.replace(temp,dest);temp=None
 res=subprocess.run(["/bin/bash",str(dest)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=40)
 report.update({"script_sha256":hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),"installer_exit":res.returncode,"stdout":res.stdout[-1800:],"stderr":res.stderr[-1100:]})
 if res.returncode!=0:
  dest.write_bytes(old);os.chown(dest,stats.st_uid,stats.st_gid);os.chmod(dest,stat.S_IMODE(stats.st_mode))
  raise RuntimeError("Installer idempotent permission repair failed; source reverted")
 assert "FERRARI_ANDROID_CLI_IDEMPOTENT=PASS" in res.stdout
 assert state.stat().st_uid==root.stat().st_uid
 assert stat.S_IMODE(state.stat().st_mode)==0o700
 assert all((state/p).stat().st_uid==root.stat().st_uid for p in ("home","cache","tmp","config","data"))
 report.update(status="PASS",state_owner_uid=state.stat().st_uid,private_mode=oct(stat.S_IMODE(state.stat().st_mode)))
except Exception as e:report.update(status="FAILED",error=str(e)[:200])
finally:
 if temp and os.path.exists(temp):os.unlink(temp)
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True))
